title: Peter Harrison Planetarium, Royal Observatory Greenwich
visualBrief: Independent exposed Peter Harrison Planetarium: mapped circular footing, oblique truncated bronze cone, sloping reflective metal cap with dark continuous rim and restrained panel seams. North rim is lower than south; X east/Z south. Preserve the independent South Building, Altazimuth Pavilion and every other campus building. Exterior above-ground cone only: underground theater, entry passages, interiors, furniture, barriers, signs and cafe are outside the mapped shell and omitted.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Shared campus Q192988 plus unique way268533449/native35184640622281, the mapped rounded planetarium cone. Own anchor raw[44.7,76.5], X east/Z south, heading0 baked into footprint. Only this parent footprint is owned; South Building, Altazimuth Pavilion and all other campus buildings remain independent. Photo-led north-facing sloped cap and near-vertical north shell establish working orientation; no surveyed engineering claim.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No mapped height. Working cone base radius about7.4m, low north rim about3.3m/high south rim9.6m, vertical north generatrix and cap inclination about38.5degrees are photo-led geometric approximations. Profile, cap/weld panels and bronze patina are simplified; shared painted-metal graph substitutes for patinated bronze and reflective cap, raw limestone for low exposed base. No unique texture or copied pixels. Underground volume and entrance are not established by this footprint and remain omitted.
